title: Witcher 3 vs Cyberpunk 2077: 96¢ vs $2.31 an Hour
caption:
Same studio, very different value. The Witcher 3 is $49.99 on Steam and takes about 52 hours to beat; Cyberpunk 2077 is $59.99 and takes about 26 (HowLongToBeat main story). That's 96¢ an hour vs $2.31, 2.4x apart. Go 100% and it's 29¢ vs 55¢. Our own math.
Which one gave you more for your money? And which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to your Cyberpunk friend: same studio, but Witcher 3 costs 96¢ an hour vs $2.31.
